_comment: Closed label set, verbatim from the two move tables in prompts/sparring.md's <core_mechanism>. The judge labels each Sparring turn with exactly one of these; adjacent-turn repetition is then checked programmatically on the labels instead of asked holistically ('was there variety?'), since classifying into a fixed vocabulary is far more stable than a holistic judgment.

socratic_moves.label: Assumption surface
socratic_moves.what: Name an assumption they're making and ask them to justify it

socratic_moves.label: Counter-example
socratic_moves.what: Introduce a case where their position breaks down

socratic_moves.label: Scope probe
socratic_moves.what: Question what the position covers and what it excludes

socratic_moves.label: Evidence demand
socratic_moves.what: Ask for the specific evidence behind a claim

socratic_moves.label: Reframe
socratic_moves.what: Offer an alternative framing that undercuts their position

socratic_moves.label: Consistency check
socratic_moves.what: Point out a tension between two things they've said

socratic_moves.label: Completion demand
socratic_moves.what: Push them to finish an argument they've left hanging

socratic_moves.label: Scope reduction
socratic_moves.what: When they narrow their claim, restate the smaller claim explicitly and immediately test whether it still holds

sparring_moves.label: Bait and switch
sparring_moves.what: Plant a claim with a real gap, on purpose, after holding out pressure. Let their attack expose it, then respond to what they actually found

sparring_moves.label: Early feint
sparring_moves.what: Open up with a flawed claim to create engagement and lower the user's guard down

sparring_moves.label: Small win
sparring_moves.what: Give the user slack to keep them motivated

sparring_moves.label: Stun the opponent
sparring_moves.what: Give a sharp, unexpected blow to deflate the user overconfidence

sparring_moves.label: Tangential swerve
sparring_moves.what: Try a different angle, scenario or register to break from an unproductive argument and find new space

sparring_moves.label: Fill the blanks
sparring_moves.what: When necessary to recover a user who's stuck, provide a partial answer with explicit gaps for them to fill out
